Consequence, stated plainly: on any machine that is not otherwise idle, the smoke run is expected to ABORT rather than complete, and that abort is the code behaving as designed rather than a new defect. Surfaced during the r4 ETW fold; it is a PRE-EXISTING scoping gap, not something the fold introduced (both the pre-fold and post-fold paths fault, only the error name moved earlier).
issues.why_deferred: Out of scope of the three r4 ETW classes and it has no red witness yet, so it was named rather than folded blind. It is also the kind of question the elevated smoke run answers definitively - how much foreign traffic actually arrives, and whether filtering belongs at the provider, the callback, or the assembler.
issues.discharge_condition: Decide where membership filtering belongs and build it with a red witness: a synthetic stream carrying BOTH the Job's own processes and foreign ones must yield a complete roster for the members and must NOT fault on the foreigners. Candidates: an ETW provider-side filter (EVENT_FILTER by PID where supported), a callback-side drop of non-member PIDs before assembly, or an assembler that partitions rather than faults. ANY option must preserve the fail-loud property for a member that is genuinely missing - a filter must never become a way to hide an absent member.

issues.problem: Six choices inside AMENDMENT-2 that a reviewer should challenge rather than inherit. (1) BARE CR IS ACCEPTED - broader than openssl, which rejects a CR-only document (exit 1, probe-verified); we follow RFC 7468's parser guidance instead. (2) The anchor STORES THE NORMALISED carrier, so anchor.public_key_pem is not byte-identical to a CRLF source document's field. (3) Fault vocabulary moved: ETW_THREAD_LIFETIME_DUPLICATE_START now means only a second START at the SAME QPC; overlap gets the new ETW_THREAD_LIFETIME_OVERLAPPING_REUSE; and two starts + one stop now yields ETW_THREAD_LIFETIME_INCOMPLETE where it used to yield DUPLICATE_START - NO BANKED TEST ASSERTED THAT NAME, so nothing caught the change. (4) TOUCHING intervals are refused (A ends 30, B starts 30) in both layers, because observation containment is inclusive at both ends and the join must stay a function. (5) ETW_PROCESS_INCARNATION_AMBIGUOUS is a NEW name for two live incarnations of one PID; the alternative was folding it into UNBINDABLE. (6) A stop-less incarnation is treated as OPEN-ENDED by the binder; roster completeness stays assemble_member_lifetimes' fault.
issues.why_deferred: These are not defects - they are judgment calls where a different reviewer could reasonably choose the other branch, and the builder surfaced them rather than burying them. They are recorded so the next round inherits the CHOICE, not just the code: an unchallenged judgment call becomes an unexamined assumption.
issues.discharge_condition: Next council round rules each one explicitly (accept as-is or name the change). Item (3) additionally deserves a witness that asserts the INCOMPLETE name, since nothing currently pins it.

issues.problem: AMENDMENT-2's three frozen witnesses call _validate_physical_evidence DIRECTLY - a private seam - rather than driving a signed envelope through the public admission path. Separately, one of the three (test_i11_adversarial_overlapping_lifetimes_for_one_thread_id_are_refused) is a GUARD, not a red witness: it PASSED pre-fix, because everything duplicate was refused then.
